channel.title: Sierra Leone - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Sierra Leone, every source cited.

item.title: Female artisanal miners report sexual violence in Kono district
item.description: Women working in the diamond-rich mines of Jaiama Nimikor face persistent threats of rape and harassment while scavenging for gold and diamonds.

item.title: Sierra Leone charcoal burning causes deforestation
item.description: Burning wood for charcoal is destroying economic trees and leaving land exposed to climate change effects.

item.title: Sierra Leone president warns kush sellers to stop
item.description: President Bio visits a drug rehabilitation facility and urges parents to find honest work.

item.title: Sierra Leone seeks Russian mining expertise
item.description: Minister Mattai wants Russian help with exploration, processing and training to boost mineral sector.

item.title: Sierra Leone secures $60.97 million for immunisation
item.description: Gavi funding will expand malaria and hepatitis B vaccines through 2030.
